result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small business or team, I'd narrow it down to **1Password and Bitwarden**\. Both are excellent, but they suit slightly different priorities.

My recommendation: **1Password if ease of use is most important; Bitwarden if value for money is the priority.**

## Top 4 password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

# \$24.95 USD/month

Teams Starter Pack · Up to 10 people

- Very easy for non-technical employees.
- Shared vaults for team credentials.
- Granular access permissions.
- Excellent admin controls and recovery features.

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

# \$4 USD/user/month

Teams plan · Annual billing

- Open-source platform.
- Shared collections and passwords.
- Admin controls and audit logs.
- Great value as your team grows.

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

(Best for security controls)

# \$2 USD/user/month

Business Starter · Annual billing

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Good security and compliance features.
- Useful for businesses with more complex access requirements.

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

(Best privacy-focused option)

# \$1.99 USD/user/month

Essentials · Annual billing

- Strong privacy focus.
- Encrypted password storage.
- Shared vaults.
- Email aliases and additional privacy features.

Website: [Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are indicative published starting prices as of November 2026, in USD before tax. Features vary by plan. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For most small teams, I'd choose 1Password.

The biggest advantage isn't simply storing passwords. It's managing access properly\:

- Employees can share credentials without sending passwords through email or Slack.
- Different departments can have separate vaults.
- You can revoke access when an employee leaves.
- You can control who can view or edit sensitive credentials.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to make sure I recommend the right one rather than just the most popular one.

**1\. How many people will use it?**

2–5 people

5–10 people

10–25 people

25–50 people

---

**2\. What does your team primarily use?**

Microsoft 365

Google Workspace

A mix of Windows, Mac and mobile

Other

---

**3\. What's most important?**

Easy to use and manage

Maximum security and control

Sharing passwords between employees

Lowest possible cost

---

**4\. Monthly budget?**

Under \$50/month

\$50–\$100/month

\$100–\$200/month

Budget isn't a major concern

[Find the best fit]

I'll use those answers to narrow it down to one recommendation and explain what it would cost for your team.
